questions: When is the moon library open?
What are the moon library opening hours?
entries.answer: The fictional moon library opens Tuesday to Friday, from 10 am to 4 pm.

questions: How many star maps can I borrow?
entries.answer: A fictional visitor may borrow two star maps for seven days.

questions: How do I book a lantern workshop?
How can I reserve a lantern workshop?
entries.answer: Reserve a fictional lantern workshop at the library desk at least one day before the session.
Paper, string and reusable lights are supplied for the fictional lantern workshop.
